batting.name: AJ Finch
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b MA Starc

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b VR Aaron

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c CH Gayle b AB Dinda

batting.name: DJG Sammy
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b HV Patel

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b VR Aaron

batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c DJG Sammy b KV Sharma

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b B Kumar

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c MC Henriques b KV Sharma

balls.text: Irfan gets the final delivery away for four over extra cover, Starc pitches it up, offers slight width, Irfan clears front leg, bends the back leg and lofts it cleanly
backs away and slogs, mishits through midwicket
he's missed a final time this innings, walked across outside off stump, Starc went full on middle, and hit it
now he gives him the bouncer, even as Warner comes across and tries to get down on a knee, the ball rears up at him, Warner misses again
yorker outside leg stump as Warner moves out and tries to make room, he misses, Irfan wants the bye now, but is sent back
full and low into the pad, Irfan cannot connect, the ball pops up on the leg side, Irfan is standing and watching before he is forced into action as Warner charges up
full and wide, Ojha reaches for it, but he hasn't gone too hard at it, and ends up slicing it to Starc, who runs to his left from sweeper cover to take it
goes way outside off stump now
this time he connects, and sends a length ball high, straight and 89 metres
short ball flies past the batsman outside off, Ojha hops and tries to steer it fine, can't reach it
full delivery, Warner cracks it along the ground to long on
makes some room and guides this bouncing delivery to third man
mid off is up, this is pitched up, but Ojha's driven this straight to him,
now Warner hammers one out of the reach of long on, Dinda gives him another full toss, Warner sends it flat and powerful, long on jumps too, like AB had, and is as successful
another full toss, lower this time, Warner drills it past the non-striker, there is no denying AB this time, he zooms across and slides in front of the sightscreen to prevent the boundary
just over long off's jump, Warner walks down the track and hammers this full toss, AB runs to his left and leaps but in vain
high full toss guided through point to the sweeper
bowled full around off, is driven back, Dinda gets down to stop it
a wide and low full toss, Warner reaches for it and drags it to long on
makes Ojha hop with another lifter from round the stumps, but the batsman does well to guide it calmly past the keeper and fine to the third man boundary
has a crack at this full delivery angled in from over the wicket, but will only get an inside edge to midwicket
rises high on him as it is angled in from round the stumps, Ojha gets on his toes and drops it in front of midwicket, it is Kohli v Warner again, and Kohli misses with the lob too now
guided  wide of third man, where Aaron dives to his right to stop the ball
another escape for Warner, and it is Kohli again, he misses from midwicket this time, Ojha had turned a short of a length ball there, and Warner had backed up too far
Starc goes full on leg stump even as Warner tries to make some room, Warner swings hard but cannot connect

the slower one at 118 kph works for Harshal, a length ball cutting in from outside off, Sammy wants to deposit it over deep midwicket but it comes off slowly and bounces, he mishits it to straight the fielder
very wide full toss, Warner reaches out and drills it through point
tries to go leg side but this is a slower one and rolls towards the keeper off the thigh pad
he's flat-batted this wide length ball 80 metres over long off, set himself up, pushed front foot out and clobbered it
Sammy cranks up for the big one, but this is not full enough to get under, and he plays it out to point instead
run out chance, needed a direct hit, Warner skipped out and slammed this full toss to Kohli at extra cover, the captain fired it in flat and quick, Warner was not even in the frame, but Kohli missed
length ball on middle and leg, he moves across to work it in front of square
floats it up way outside the off stump now
leans forward to a pitched up ball and drives past cover to the sweeper
another wrong 'un pitching outside off and spinning further away, Warner stretches for a cut, cannot beat point
wrong 'un, Sammy is going back to make room but it spins in and is inside-edged to short fine leg
slips it flat down the leg side even as Sammy fails to connect
goes flat and sits up outside off for the cut, but Warner's stroke finds point
Chahal begins his last over and is taken for maximum down the ground first ball, as Warner skips out, reaches the pitch and powers it high and into the sightscreen
pitched up around off stump, Sammy drills it back, Dinda gets down and prevents it from going down the ground
a full toss now, but Warner cannot hit it hard enough to beat long on who reaches it to his right
and again, a shade wider but in the blockhole again, Warner cannot connect this time too
yorker angled across the left-hander, just outside off, Warner gets low and tries to squeeze it away but misses
turns this length ball to wide long on for a single
good length, close to off stump, defended to the bowler
not the first time Dhawan's fallen to the pull, he's mishit it to AB at deep midwicket, it was a short ball around chest height
walks way outside off trying to scoop this to fine leg, but the ball is not pitched up, and bounces past Dhawan's bat-swing
in the blockhole outside off, Warner squeezes it to Starc at backward point, who misfields
chops this short of a length ball on the stumps square on the off side
Warner has blasted this length delivery but there is long off, a few bounces and down to him
full and very wide, Dhawan reaches for it and slaps it to the sweeper, they think about the overthrow, but Dhawan is ultimately sent back
is that an edge! Parthiv was interested, and I heard something as the ball passed the bat.. But Harshal turns around and takes his hat. Strange
looks to cut the short of length delivery, but misses it completely
slower ball, Warner spots it early and plays a double-handed forehand winner down the line! No chance for anyone there
this time he decides to wait for the ball rather than throw bat on it, he opens the face of the bat late and runs it down to third man
looks to cut a length delivery, but this was not short enough. He is beaten
that is brilliantly cut off by the point fielder! He dives to his left and saves extra runs from a cracking cut shot
another backfoot punch from Dhawan  as he spots the shortness in the length early, but he is not able to beat Gayle at backward point
that stayed a touch low! Warner was shaping to pull as this was short, but toe-ends it to long off
tossed up and it turns a touch away, was the googly. Dhawan calmly presses forward and dabs it to point for a single
waits on the back foot and cracks it to deep backward point for a couple
he uses his feet and slaps the low full toss calmly over the umpire's head..
this was much slower from Chahal, allowed Warner all the time in the world to go back and punch it to deep midwicket
gets a short of length delivery and whacks it along the ground to deep midwicket, AB is manning the boundary there.. so just a single
length delivery with loads of width this time! He missed out in the last delivery but not this time, Warner plants his front foot out and crashes this through extra cover
fuller length delivery outside off but Warner misses out, punching this straight back at the bowler
shortish again and Dhawan tries to pull this behind square, but gets an underedge on to his body. They pick up a single but Dhawan is in some pain after taking that blow to his thigh
digs this one short and this one flies over the batsman's head, it's called a wide
that's typical Dhawan this time! There is hardly any room in that one as it comes in with the angle, but he somehow creates room and cracks it past backward point.. That raced to the boundary
sharp length delivery outside off, doesn't bounce much this time. Dhawan throws his bat at that and misses
shorter this time, allows Dhawan the space to rock back and pull it to deep midwicket
oh, Warner charges down the pitch after Dhawan dabs this floater to point.. He is almost halfway down the pitch, but makes it back in time
there is some room this time and Warner chops it to deep cover for a single
another googly, Warner chooses to stay in the crease and gets beaten
now he uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and drives it firmly to off, but that's straight to the fielder at cover
stays back to the googly and ends up sending the leading edge to cover.. Just drops short
angled across again and ending around off, Dhawan is cramped for room and runs it to backward point
stands in the crease and lets this climbing back of a length ball angle across him outside off
struck well but backward point dives to get a hand to it, and it rolls towards deep point
one more around the thigh pad, and Warner works it to the deep backward square leg boundary
pitching outside leg and angling across towards middle, he pushes it towards cover for one
short of a length, into the body, punched straight back to the bowler
punched off the back foot to wide long off
sliding across the left-hander from a length, slapped down to long on
full delivery slogged down to wide long on from outside off
shortish ball pulled to deep midwicket
cut to the sweeper for a single
he's kept bowling on the legs, and this time he pays for it, a short of a length ball rises without much bite and is pulled hard, in front of square, no chance for deep square leg
good length into the pad, worked square for a single
a slower one going across the left-hander, Warner has a go at it, but only thin-edges it into the ground and to the keeper
short of a length and bouncing on the left-hander, dropped softly and square on off for one
this should have gone too, back of a length and well down the leg side,  but Dhawan cannot connect
turned past Gayle at midwicket and wide of mid on for a single
it is down the leg side but Dhawan does not get enough bat on it and cannot tuck wide enough of fine leg
he's pummeled this short of a length ball off the back foot but found cover
Warner reaches out to a length ball and thick-edges the drive just out of the reach of a flying backward point, AB rushes after it from cover
pushes a back of a length ball to the bowler, who cannot field, mid on tidies up
short at 143 kph but it pitches outside leg and bounces just past Warner
nothing out of the free hit, it is in the blockhole widish outside off, Warner tries a big drive but misses
Aaron over-steps as he bowls it back of a length outside off
shot! Warner starts with an exquisite boundary, he stands half forward and punches this length ball sweetly through the covers
Dhawan under-edges an attempted cut square on the off side for a single
this was short and wide, but Rahul has edged the cut, and Gayle has moved to his left at slip to take a head-high catch
pitched up, and moving in a bit towards off, it is turned to mid on, Harshal charges in, but he fails to pick the ball up, and a second run is taken
just short of a length, widish outside off, played out to backward point
Dinda drops it short, and Rahul hooks it over square leg, bounces inches before the boundary
back of a length ball punched to mid off
a length ball, into the pad, Dhawan tucks it past square leg, who chases and slides to pull it back in near the rope
short of a length, 139.3 kph, Rahul plays it down square on the leg side

Starc bounces out Finch, a 140 kph lifter into the body, Finch tries to gather himself into playing a hook, but it rises up too fast, and he's in no position to play the shot, he is hopping in the air, trying to half-fend, half-hook, and only ends up looping it to the keeper
another one on the pad, very full though, Dhawan flicks hard, but straight to fine leg
back of a length, but on the pads, and Dhawan helps it past short fine
beats him with a good length outswinger outside off as Dhawan goes following it
Finch goes over the off side now, a pitched up ball allowing him enough width to have a go, and he lofts it cleanly just over the deep cover rope
that is right through Yuvraj at square leg, that should have been stopped easily, Finch toe-ended a pull from outside off, it was close to Yuvraj's right, he slid across too, but it raced past
137.4 kph back of a length, coming into the batsman, who fails to tuck it to leg, Dinda rushes forward to prevent the single
pushes this full one to wide mid off for an easy single
Dinda gets away, a length delivery is smashed straight to cover

Dinda starts right on target too, with a pitched up ball holding its line on off stump, is pushed to the off side, AB runs across from extra cover and dives forward to try and lob the ball at the non-striker's end, but only succeeds in parrying it to mid off, Kohli runs after it to cut off the chance of another run
pitches it up to end the over, bang on off stump, Dhawan stays in the crease and guides it to point
just back of a length, 143 kph, and it does not carry to the keeper even as Dhawan lets it go outside off
straightening on middle on a full length, nudged square on the leg side
pitched up to the left-hander as well, who adjusts for the movement and pushes it past the bowler for one, mid on fields
swinging in right on off stump this time, full length, Finch pushes and gets a thick inside edge square to the leg side
very low full toss to start off, swings in a tad just outside off, Finch cannot connect as he pushes at it
AB does it with a ball to spare, it is a low full toss, he smashes it in the gap to the deep midwicket boundary
has another swing, inside edges the full delivery to square leg, AB is back on strike
a slower one, Harshal has a swing and a miss, tries to take a bye, falls onto the pitch, but just stretches his bat in
AB moves wide outside off stump to try the scoop again, cannot get hold of it, the ball rolls square on the off side
Starc forces the length ball to mid off, but is found well short on the direct hit
he's taken Steyn apart once more, walks across way outside off, gets down and scoops him into the third tier over the fine leg boundary, what a man... Dale Steyn claps
mid off is up, Steyn goes full just outside off, AB goes back and across and lofts him calmly to the wide long off boundary
Starc flays at this pitched up delivery, inside edges it to midwicket, turns the strike over, which is he needs to do
this could have gone too, a full toss on the pad, AB misses, Steyn screams for lbw, it was headed down leg though
into the sightscreen now, full delivery, AB walks to off, moves forward and lofts it over Steyn
Steyn goes for six first ball, a slow offcutter on a good length, AB picks it over deep square leg
he tries the reverse-paddle again, hits it to Irfan at short third man, keeps the strike, Irfan resists the urge to have a go at the stumps with Bhuvneshwar nowhere near the stumps
AB improvises, Bhuvneshwar sticks to full and wide outside off, but AB stretches forward and reverse-paddles it past short third man
terrific stuff from Bhuvneshwar, this is a yorker closer to off now, AB is beaten once more
another dot, Bhuvneshwar goes full and wide again, well inside the marker, AB lets it be
wide yorker, AB tries to reach it, cannot connect as it  moves away
he starts full and wide as well, AB throws his bat at it, slices it high over backward point
almost chops this full delivery on, AB thinks about sneaking in a single initially, Starc hesitates as bowler and keeper charge in, AB backs off in the end
full and wide again, AB cannot get under it and flays it down to long off
sees AB walk across outside off stump and hurls it wide, clearly past the marker, but Dharmasena says AB had moved too far
bouncer, moving away outside off, AB watches it and pulls away in the end
slower ball on a length, Starc pushes it to sweeper cover to bring AB back on strike
there was a chance for a run out, but Sammy cannot pick up the ball at mid off after AB drills a full delivery straight to him
leading edge to end the over with a single to the sweeper
Sammy tries a slower one at 107 kph, it sits up outside off, and AB pummels it over deep midwicket, not a clean hit but RCB don't care as long as it goes over, it is also fifty for AB off 23 balls
a full toss, AB clobbers it over the straight boundary, long off wasn't too far, he also had no chance
drives to the sweeper, Henriques slips as he approaches the ball, but no harm done as he stops it and gets rid of it quickly
fuller delivery, he goes after it again, scythes it down to long off
full and wide, AB catapults it way over the long off boundary for a mammoth maximum
turned off the pad in front of square and even as deep midwicket runs in, they take the second comfortably
thick inside edge to short fine leg as he swings at a full one
straightens on the left hander from a length, defended off the front foot
Yuvraj is gone now, he's swept it to deep backward square leg, Henriques the substitute is there in the deep, he steadies himself at the edge of the rope and takes it over his head
backs away, this one hurries towards the stumps, Yuvraj dabs it to cover, AB wants the single, he is half way up before being sent back
Yuvraj comes down the track and lofts straight over the bowler, he actually got too close to the pitch but got front leg out of the way and swung it over
taps this length ball on off to cover and keep strike
moving away outside off stump, Yuvraj is beaten as he tries to run it square
full one driven to the sweeper
dropped, tough chance at backward point, AB cuts, Karn Sharma jumps and stretches out his left hand, gets fingers to it but it does not stick
this full toss would have a wide had AB not moved across and tried to go leg side, hit it back to the bowler in the end
full and wide from round the wicket, AB gets on the front foot, gets down on a knee and lofts it over extra cover
Yuvraj square-drives a full delivery crisply, but finds point in the way
missed out this time, slogs a wide full toss toss to long on
Sammy goes full and wide, AB stretches and throws bat at it, thick edge flies past the keeper
pushes another length delivery in front of extra cover and they take a sharp single, throw to the keeper was wide
cranks up to try a big one but pushes the length delivery back to the bowler
very full around off, Yuvraj squeezes it out to point on the bounce
Ishant sends this full and just outside off, AB comes forward and launches it high and straight down the ground
makes room outside leg and carves this length ball to sweeper cover
Ishant responds with a proper short ball now, and pings Yuvraj smack on the back of the helmet as the batsman swivels and misses the hook
this wasn't too short, but Yuvraj's reacted fast, he's crouched and whip-pulled it behind square leg
direct hit needed as Yuvraj turns this length ball to midwicket and AB charges up for the run which wasn't there, but Rahul misses
full, slow and on the stumps, AB adjusts to drive to long on
legbreak turned with the spin to square leg
goes back as he sees the shorter length, but it comes in to the right-hander, he drags it in front of square
tossed up and bowled full into middle and leg, AB defends
comes down the track to work it down to long on
presses forward to defend down the track
loud, long appeal for leg-before, Karn tosses it up full on the stumps, Rossouw tries the reverse sweep, misses and is struck right in front
this time he has the width as Irfan goes full outside off, AB slogs him over long on, right into the waste bin lying in front of the Sunrisers dugout
was moving across trying to go over midwicket probably but this swung in to him and he did not have the room to have a go at it
floats it too wide outside off, AB tries to reach it, misses
pitched up and straightening again, cannot time the drive, takes the single to mid off
charges out and has a swing, but is beaten as this back of a length ball moves away
full on the stumps, he pushes it straight past the bowler to mid off
angled across full outside off and swings in a bit, is smashed through extra cover to wide long off
tossed up on a length and hurries across with the angle at 90 kph, he tries to cut but is beaten
tries to paddle this full one from just outside off, cannot connect
turned off the pad to short fine leg
that has gone through Rahul at point, Rossouw moved across and punched it straight to the fielder
moves across to this full delivery, turns it in front of square, they are going back for the second, Rossouw has to dive, and he does
skips out, yorks himself on this flighted one, inside edges it square on the leg side
into the pad, tucked through square leg for a very easy two runs
a slower one, AB is early into the drive, he tries to adjust, but hits it in the air just wide of backward points dive
tries the short ball but digs it too short and it rises way over the batsman
good length ball slanted across a bit, he punches it nicely to sweeper cover
length ball pitches outside leg and hits the pad as he fails to work it square
flays a full and wide delivery out to sweeper cover
now the running will be much quicker with AB in, Rossouw punches wide of cover and sets off, Warner fires it in, does not hit, Rossouw would have made it anyway
brilliantly bowled, flighted again, this time on the stumps, AB defends, leaves a gap between bat and pad, this does not turn, but an inside edge saves AB
now he tosses it up to the new batsman, AB follows it outside off, and is beaten
the legspinner has struck big first over, Gayle has swung this flat and  pitched up delivery off his pad straight to Sammy at deep midwicket
quicker one on a length around off, he tries to pull it, hits it down to long on
drags it shortish on the pad, Gayle only works it to deep midwicket
full around off stump, Gayle pushes it back
angles it in to the left-hander just outside off, Rossouw has a drive at it and is beaten
pushed to mid off
moves to off stump and tries to square drive again, underedges it
a tad fuller and closer to off, angling across, Rossouw square-drives to point
Rossouw drills this length ball down the ground, takes it from well outside off and hits it past the bowler on the on side
moves forward and pushes this length ball wide of cover, who gets around to it and there is no single
another maximum, Ishant drops it short now, around chest height into the let-hander, and Gayle swivels to hook it over deep square leg
he connects alright now, a length ball on off, Gayle's front leg goes to the on side and the ball travels over the deep midwcket boundary

slogs a length ball off the inner part of the bat through midwicket, Dhawan has little hope chasing it from midwicket, but Sammy is there in the deep, however, his dive is too early, and the ball slips past
cramps him for room with a length ball around off, Gayle tries to back away but his punch goes to mid off
has a crack at this short ball going across outside off, toe-ends it to the keeper
pushes this hard into the pitch, it bounces over the bowler, mid on runs across, dives and parries it towards mid off
length ball slanted across worked straight to square leg
Bhuvneshwar gets away this time, Rossouw tries to force this one outside leg very fine, but misses
tucked square off the pad, there is an easy two there as fine leg runs across, but Gayle is not turning back
starts outside leg on a length and moves across the left-hander who defends
away to third man for a single
saw this moving across and shuffled to try the cut, but it started to swing in and beat him, was caught in a very awkward position there
he's swung hard at this length ball and sliced it high over the off-side infield, one bounce over the deep cover boundary
chance at mid on as Gayle mishits the pull off a sharp short ball, Dhawan dives forward but it falls just short
punches the length delivery to mid off
this is a 147.6 kph length ball from Steyn, and it has come back faster at the bowler, goes screaming just past his right leg
plays from the crease, this is a length ball hurrying on towards the stumps, he keeps it out, just in time
Gayle cracks this length ball through the off side, Rahul flies to his right at extra cover to stop it, Rossouw is too far up the pitch, but the throw misses

they have the big one, Bhuvneshwar ends a superb over on a high, this was much shorter than the length he had been bowling, it swung away, Kohli saw some width to cut, and nicked it through to the keeper
driven straight to cover
this comes in with the angle and makes him play just outside off, Kohli is forward to defend
angled in and straightens outside off, Kohli comes across and lets it go
gets closer to off stump, and moves it away slightly from a length, is left alone
floats it up wide and it swings further away outside off
Bhuvneshwar strikes first ball, he bowls it on a good length around off, it is swinging away a bit, Parthiv drives at it without much feet, and plays on
back of a length, on the stumps, Gayle stays back and plays it out quietly to point
stays in the crease and pushes away from the body again, thick edge goes to third man
beaten this time, pushed away from the body to a 144 kph length ball leaving him
Parthiv comes across and tucks this length ball between midwicket and square leg, Dhawan and Sammy runs after it, Dhawan pulls it back and Sammy throws it in
slants it across Parthiv at 138 kph, is left alone, it keeps climbing as it approaches the keeper
good length again, turned off the pad to Ishant at fine leg
good length, moving in, and slips down leg at 141 kph
